zones.fiction: Span-gauge galvanized lattice and structural alloy posts bought from the common yard (THE_COMMON_YARD §1). Load-bearing chords, not decoration.
zones.manufacture: rolled steel chords + welded lattice; galvanized truss family; bare steel patches where re-welded
zones.coating: hot-dip galv or mid-value industrial paint
zones.wear: seam dirt at bays, scuff at clamp rails, localized reweld scorch
zones.forbidden: plastic tubes, clay-smooth cylinders, default Principled plastic

zones.fiction: Who owns the yard: ochre extraction, teal logistics, navy authority, service blue, rust salvage (THE_COMMON_YARD §3).
zones.manufacture: shop-sprayed dielectric coat over alloy; patch plates never colour-matched
zones.wear: contact dirt at seams/fasteners only — not whole-surface clay mottling
zones.forbidden: charcoal mud, glossy car paint, uniform noise dirt

zones.fiction: Pressure loads live in cylinders/spheres with end-domes and cradle saddles; insulated runs wear amber wrap.
zones.manufacture: formed pressure shell + saddle cradle; wrap is fibreglass/amber insulation
zones.wear: saddle contact, wrap fray at clamps

zones.fiction: Light colour is the trade code (THE_COMMON_YARD §2 / THE_WORKING_LIGHT). Floods, amber extraction, blue service, arc-blue authority, green/red lane.
zones.manufacture: hooded fixture with recessed emitter; never a bare glowing disk
zones.wear: lens grime; hood scorch on salvage reds

zones.fiction: Hazard bands mark risk; ore is rough non-metal stock; scorch is thermal damage on salvage/process faces.
zones.manufacture: painted hazard tape / dumped ore / heat damage
zones.coating: none for ore; carbon for scorch
zones.forbidden: smooth metallic ore, decorative hazard without meaning

shapeGrammarNote: Donor pack was blockout cubes/cylinders/trusses. Form revisions stay proportional: gameplay-distance read at 90–140 WU is the acceptance camera, not close-up jewellery.
